XRA-PS-02-AC03.localFinding: The real pinned KaleidoSphere native-projection service at the exact released head (commit 545a3b44, tree c0699e1b) was launched inside the dedicated root test VM, its real loopback HTTP response was fed to the independent PAN verifier, and it reproduced the historical capture byte-for-byte (matchesHistoricalCapture). The transported projection artifact was generated from the released producer at execution time and its byte-equality to the released raw artifact and to the independently rebuilt projection is recorded. The complete seven-stage chain is bound per stage by raw execution identities, commands, and input/output byte digests in addition to the derived chain digests. The five paired outcomes, the real service-down/substitution/malformed wire falsifiers, and a real mutation-route falsifier (the authority-free service refuses /v1/pansphaira-analytics/promote with XRA_KS01_ROUTE_DENIED) were executed repository-rooted. The before/after comparison is an actual state observation: the canonical Knowledge pin bytes and the KS flat release registry / native sidecar file bytes were re-read at T0 (before service start and before any adjudication) and at T1 (after the five outcomes and all wire falsifiers), and authority, capability delta, and effect are derived from those observations rather than assumed. All of this is bound by the v2 successor paired receipt, which independently binds the immutable released input heads (inputHeadsDigest) and the tested PAN adjudicator source (testedSourceDigest) separately. The v1 source-local receipt is structurally insufficient: it binds no tested source and no live execution, and is fail-closed DENIED as a v2 successor receipt.
